assumptions: Uses the supplied match3 event-driven runtime through createGame adapter.
Task board/colors/moves initialize a 4x4 board with a default score objective of 100 when none is provided.
Resolution and objectives settle synchronously within each accepted swap; there is no intermediate animation state exposed.
Mapped declared board/moves/colors aliases and public lowercase swap form; same-instance acceptance logging and canvas pointer projection use the rendered board geometry.

GRAVITY and OBJECTIVE_CHECK are local adapter projections bracketed by native GemsCleared/GemFell/GemRefilled and ObjectiveCompleted/Terminal/StateAdvanced witnesses. The frozen Runtime state, matching, gravity, refill, RNG and objectives are unchanged.
Every drag whose source and destination resolve to board cells is submitted to native swap validation, including nonadjacent and otherwise rejected pairs; drags outside the board are ignored.
The public snapshot exposes configured objective type/target and authoritative progress; the HUD renders every objective target and current value, preserving the default score target of 100.
